description: Power factor controller and network analyser (24 steps): three-phase measurements with harmonics up to the 51st, step counters, energy meters, monthly demand, alarm log and communication settings

sources.title: Manual del Usuario RAPIDUS
sources.note: Section 4.5, Modbus data tables for the 232R-E

notes: Modbus RTU on RS-485, functions 03, 06, 10 and 14 (read file record). Addresses start at 0 and every value is 32 bits in two registers (floats are IEEE 754, high word first: the manual's example 43 5D 36 E0 is 221.21 V).
Slave ID 1 to 247 and baud rate are set on the device or in registers; 9600 8N1 and ID 1 are assumed here.

The alarm flag registers are 32-bit with the high word first: bits 0 to 15 are in the second register and bits 16 to 31 in the first. A bit set to 1 is an alarm; a few labels in the manual's alarm 2 table are repeated (THDV), so they are shown as printed.

Only the live data, the alarm log, the archive numbers and the main communication settings are listed. The rest of the configuration table (steps, targets, alarm limits, display settings, from 2006 on) is in the manual and is not included.
The text of the manual is a scan; it was read with OCR and checked against the page images for the alarm tables.
Written from the manufacturer's manual (Spanish); not tested on a device.
